101.text: Our grasping policy trained only in sim now hits 87% success on deformable objects (bags, cables) on a real UR5. Sim2real gap mostly came from friction randomisation.
Hiring: robotics engineer in Singapore who likes debugging grippers at 2am.
Hot take: most embodied AI demos are teleoperated. Ask for the failure videos.

102.text: Released a 1.5B Vietnamese instruction-tuned model. Beats 7B multilingual baselines on our VN reading comprehension set. Weights + eval code open.
Tokenizers matter more than people think for Vietnamese: diacritics blow up sequence length 30-40% on English-first tokenizers.

103.text: v0.4 of our LLM eval toolkit: regression tests for prompts, runs in CI, flags when a model upgrade silently breaks your app.
Talked to 30 AI startups in Manila: almost none have evals. They ship on vibes.
